title: Seven years
venue: Arthur's site (newspaper cadence: six dailies + a Sunday)
logline: Seven years. The corn is on the drafting table. The stick figures have opinions about the corn.

panels.composition: The garage. A tray of corn on the drafting table. WOOD drawing. BARNABY. At the back, four stick figures now.

image.prompt: a young man drawing at a drafting table in a garage with a paper tray of corn beside him, a small dog, and four small stick figures at the back of the panel talking among themselves, muddy digital flats

balloons.text: Seven years ago I drew a cafeteria. This is what's left of it.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man drawing, not turning to answer, lamp light

panels.composition: A stick figure has come forward and is looking at the corn.

balloons.text: can we see the cafeteria one

image.prompt: a small stick figure standing beside a paper tray of corn on a drafting table, looking at it

panels.composition: Wood pinning #1 — the original, yellowed cardstock — to the garage wall beside the corkboard. The stick figures gathered under it, reading. The dog asleep.

characters.pose: pinning an old strip to the wall

image.prompt: a young man pinning a yellowed old comic strip to a garage wall while four small stick figures gather beneath it to read, a dog asleep, no words
image.notes: #1's original on the wall from here on. Visible in garage backgrounds through 2027.

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy early-digital flats begin
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in over-wet watercolor

notes: Seven. The chorus reads #1. The original goes on the wall for good.
